it reversed the verse; the Lord turns on Israel the plan he had for the nations

actions.new_text: Planning or intending: the Assyrian's heart is set on destroying nations, the prophets intend to make the people forget the name, the Lord will do to his people what he planned for the nations, and the one who speaks against God intends to change times and laws. The verbs are of devising and purpose. Verses: Job 6:26, Isa 10:7, Jer 23:27, Dan 7:25, Num 33:56, 1Sa 18:25.
actions.checked: Num 33:56 (I will do to you as I thought to do to them)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it reversed the verse; the Lord turns on Israel the plan he had for the nations

it named unbelief as what is judged incredible; the verse names God's raising the dead

actions.new_text: Reckoning something as so, judging or counting: Paul judges it necessary, a thing is counted unclean by the one who holds it so, God's raising of the dead is judged incredible in Act 26:8, Judah takes the covered woman for a prostitute, and Job 41:32 counts the deep as white-haired. The word is a judgment that counts or takes something as of a certain kind. Verses: Job 35:2, Job 41:32, 2Cor 12:6, 2Pe 1:13, Rom 14:14, Gen 38:15, Act 26:8, 2Cor 9:5, Phili 2:25.
actions.checked: Act 26:8 (Why is it thought incredible by any of you that God raises the dead)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it named unbelief as what is judged incredible; the verse names God's raising the dead
